input.subject: Weekend Sale at the Coffee Shop – This Saturday & Sunday Only!
input.body:
Hi there,

Our weekend sale is almost here, and we'd love to see you!

This Saturday and Sunday, stop by for special savings on your favorite drinks, pastries, and freshly roasted beans. Whether you're after your usual morning espresso or a treat to share with friends, there's something for everyone.

What to expect:
- Special weekend pricing on select drinks and pastries
- Great deals on retail coffee beans
- Our friendly baristas ready to help you find your new favorite

Sale details (dates, hours, and discounts) to be confirmed before sending.

Offers are available while supplies last, so come early!

See you this weekend,
The Coffee Shop Team

P.S. Forward this email to a friend who loves great coffee!
